_cooldown_note: After the batch, Flow is switched to a random ratio and model and 1..images throwaway images are made (never kept, screenshots in debug/cooldown). images 0 = off. Env FLOW_COOLDOWN_IMAGES overrides it.
_aspect_options: portrait (9:16) | landscape (16:9) | square (1:1) | 3:4 | 4:3. Overridable per run from the workflow inputs.
_allowedModels_note: Model names are checked loosely against this list before Chrome starts. Add new Flow model names here.
_status_note: PARTIAL_SUCCESS exits 0 with a warning. Set failOnPartial to true to make it fail the job. FAILED (no usable images) always fails.
